title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 6 in D minor

character.text: Binary dance- or sonata-type fugue, with the subject inverted after the midpoint

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 31–33).
sections.leads: From D minor to A major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A major (Soprano); Subject in D minor, inverted (Alto)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted. Returns in Episode 6 (bars 36–38).
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A minor (Bass); Subject in A minor (Alto)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Link (bar 42).
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor; perfect cadence in A minor at bar 21

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Bass); Subject in D minor, inverted, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in D minor, inverted (Bass)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every beat. Alto: the opening of the subject, inverted. Bass: the opening of the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor, inverted (Soprano); Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in G minor, inverted (Bass)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 10–12) in part, with soprano and bass exchanged, transposed. Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Alto: the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From G minor to D major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D major (Bass); Subject in G minor (Soprano); Subject in G minor, inverted (Alto)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bar 16) in part, in the same voices, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: the opening of the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From G minor to D minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Bass); Subject in D minor (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 3 (bar 20), in the same voices, a fourth higher. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in D minor at bar 43

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1.
